archetypes.name: step5b-parity
archetypes.rationale: Step 5b preserves retired Bash control-flow contracts in Python.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new Step 5b Python entrypoints against the retired wrapper behavior. Focus on pause-save ordering, sentinel writes, stdout and stderr capture, non-zero handling, and issue stdout path consistency. Check that ready, skip, failure, and annotate paths produce the expected machine rows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: wrapper-routing
archetypes.rationale: Thin wrappers and CLI registry changes affect live /design launcher routing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 5 and Step 5b wrapper changes with the CLI registry updates. Focus on whether launcher compatibility remains intact for skills/design/SKILL.md fences and older paused sessions. Check that documentation siblings match the new direct Python targets without introducing stale wrapper references. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
